scope: High-current distribution runs on top/bottom. Low-current terminal branches may use inner layers. Current and signal-integrity qualification remain separate fabrication gates.

branches.basis: Q2 powers only amplifier SD_MODE through R63=100 ohms; R62=1 kohm pulls its gate. Amplifier supply pins U3.2/7/8 use VSYS directly. A conservative 5.5 V rail bounds even a grounded SD_MODE input at 55 mA plus 5.5 mA gate pull. This is a control branch, not the amplifier supply trunk.
100 kohm charger PGOOD pull-up, at 3.3 V; logic branch, not a supply trunk.
100 kohm charger status pull-up, at 3.3 V; logic branch, not a supply trunk.
Regulator power-good pull-up only. Does not feed a powered load.
Auxiliary 100 nF capacitor branch. Main MCU supply and local C31 bypass retain their separate routes. AC bypass and loop impedance remain unqualified.
Voltage measurement pad; this branch is not a power output.
